features.title: Sharpshooter
features.text: High firearm and crossbow accuracy rewards carefully set-up shots. Reloading is part of your combat rhythm, and some builds focus on helping allies land their attacks.

features.title: Ways and deeds
features.text: Your way combines reloads with movement, skill actions or other tricks. Choose equipment and feats that work with that routine.
